card.name: Animal toxicity signs in lists
card.fires_on: Linking words and commas just before or within a list of toxic signs seen in animals (mice, rats, monkeys) after high doses, such as 'included', ',', 'and', 'decreased'. It fires where the next item is a sign like decreased activity, body weight loss or tremors.

modes.label: Lead-in to signs
modes.description: Verb or word that introduces observed toxic signs in animals after a high dose.
modes.example: symptoms of toxicity in affected mice<< included>> decreased locomotor activity, staggering gait

modes.label: Commas and 'and' in sign lists
modes.description: Separators between listed signs of acute toxicity in animal studies.
modes.example: The signs of acute toxicity were decreased motor activity<<,>> piloerection and generalized edema

modes.label: Body weight and appetite loss
modes.description: Words just before body weight or appetite changes in animal toxicity findings.
modes.example: there were increased mortality and/or moribundity and<< decreased>> body weight and body weight gain at

card.writes: It likely pushes the model toward 'weights' and body-weight words, as in 'decreased body weight'.
card.plain: It lights up in animal toxicity text where a list of signs like reduced activity or weight loss is being written out.
